title: Measured progress
description: Three synthetic tasks, twelve chronological stages, used during development. Both paths use GPT-4o-mini and the same exact checks. Offload totals include Jev selection and archive recovery. Selection budget: 3,000 characters.
limitation: The baseline failed one check by adding an extra JSON field. Its owner and readiness were correct. These cases were used during development. Combined monetary cost is unknown.

repeated.description: Four synthetic snapshots, five answers per path. Both paths use GPT-4o-mini and the same exact checks. All Jev scoring is included. Reusing unchanged context makes its initial selection cost worthwhile. Selection budget: 1,600 characters.
repeated.limitation: Repeated snapshots are an optimistic microbenchmark. First-use compaction costs more; this does not establish savings on every task. Provider-reported cost was $0.000714378 versus $0.0023805.

reliability.title: Assigned drafts
reliability.description: Declared file checks passed after the prompt fix. Calls fell from 7 to 3, tokens from 1,721 to 815. These checks assess phrases, size and JSON, not broad quality.

reliability.title: Bounded working memory
reliability.description: Maximum checkpoint: 18,852 bytes versus 1,245,224. The full 1,242,822-byte source remains recoverable. This measures bytes, not model tokens.

reliability.title: Idle Sleep counter
reliability.description: One paid call, 1,346 tokens, $0.0014084. Increment and Reset passed; restart added zero calls. One synthetic case with an injected idle clock.

personal.title: A research session spanning 48.6 hours
personal.quote: must be a real person's account, not a brand or businesses
personal.quoteSource: Actual user instruction before the replay cutoff. Session span is provenance, not replay runtime.
personal.result: Earlier frozen trials passed 63/93 and 64/93 research criteria. The latest prompt + model pilot reaches 29/31 on each path. Neither artifact fully passes.
personal.conditions: Both paths use the same frozen input and evaluator. Valid files now take one call, but a numeric boundary and a target-app interpretation fail the frozen criteria. This was a development replay; Jev made zero calls.

personal.title: 145 messages, with every instruction retained
personal.result: The original policy protects 31,287 of 67,208 serialized characters, above the 16,000-character selection budget.
personal.conditions: The preflight made zero model calls. The harness now checks this floor before scoring, preserving exact archived sources. This is a boundary test, not a successful compaction run.

personal.title: Full-history selection still needs work
personal.result: The reference used 20,811 tokens and passed 9 of 12 checks. Offload used 33,285 selector tokens, retained 67,081 of 67,208 characters, and could not fit the 16,000-character budget. It produced no answer.
personal.conditions: One development pair with all 145 original messages and trusted roles. All user instructions remained protected. Seven selector calls retained 103 of 104 eligible assistant records. No token-savings or successful-output claim is possible.

personal.title: The failed experiments count, too
personal.result: 43 paid calls. 258,093 tokens. $0.0435863 reported cost, including every personal replay experiment.
personal.conditions: Includes the failed original batch, diagnostic, frozen follow-up artifacts, development artifacts and the failed full-history selection. No personal history or full artifact contents are in the public receipt.

research.title: Research replay
research.scorer: Not called: history is under budget
research.description: One paired artifact replay from frozen pre-cutoff personal history, with an independent evaluator kept out of model inputs. Both paths use the same model, task, tools and limits. The prompt and model changed jointly from the earlier failed runs.
research.limitation: Neither artifact fully passes. The two provider requests are identical and Jev is not activated. Differences are generation variation, not compaction benefits. Checks are limited proxies, not overall semantic quality.

presentationComparisons.label: GPT-6 Astra
presentationComparisons.description: 2 full paired trials, each with three synthetic tasks and twelve changing-context stages. Both arms use GPT-6 Astra, identical goals, checks, archive tools and per-call limits. SDK reference receives full history; Offload selects context and can recover the originals.
presentationComparisons.limitation: Development fixtures, not independent unseen tasks or a broad reasoning benchmark. Exact JSON checks cover facts and required format. All-in Offload cost remains unknown because selector prices are absent. Request scheduling waits count in arm latency. Provider routing and caching are uncontrolled.
